# My director's loan account is overdrawn: how much tax, and by when?

> Free UK director's loan calculator: the s455 tax on an overdrawn director's loan account, the date it is due, the benefit-in-kind on loans over £10,000, and whether a dividend, a bonus or repaying is the cheapest way to clear it. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
